The main takeaway from our work is that

the constraints on DM models from the M31 data are comparable to those from dwarf spheroidal galaxy observations, but with the additional advantage that the degeneracy between DM and astrophysical emission is significantly weaker.
the Fermi-LAT data of M31 can provide useful constraints on DM annihilation, although the constraints are weaker than those from dwarf spheroidal galaxy observations in general.
